summary.text: Anquam Mahamoud is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 62B, a seat she has held since January 2025, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Her career experience includes serving as chief operating officer of Twin Cities Health Services on Lake and Hennepin and as a state planning director at MNsure.

paragraphs.text: Anquam Mahamoud earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from St. Catherine University.

Her career experience includes serving as the COO of Twin Cities Health Services on Lake and Hennepin and as the State Planning Director for Individual Market Policy, Eligibility, and Enrollment for MNsure.
Mahamoud defeated Republican Bob Sullentrop in the 2024 general election for District 62B and assumed office on January 14, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy, Health Finance and Policy, and Judiciary Finance and Civil Law committees.
Bob Sullentrop is her Republican opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election, after both parties' August primaries were canceled.
